desc:
Welcome to Score Goals for Brainrots! ⚽ 
Can you reach the top of the world and win the world cup?

Score goals and collect 120+ different Brainrots! ⭐
Level up your Brainrots manually to unlock their true potential! 📈
Your Brainrots keep earning money even while you're OFFLINE! 💰

Buy upgrades to boost your power and kick further than ever!
Unlock powerful Soccer Balls with insane effects! ⚽🔥
Score goals on 10 increasingly difficult stadiums as you climb the ranks! 📈

Dominate the global leaderboard and flex on your friends! 🏆
Rebirth to reset your progress, grow stronger, and multiply your rewards! 💸
Enjoy crazy hourly events that shake up the field! 🎉

The ultimate Football/Soccer game! ⚽

Like the game and join the community for future updates! 👍
